purpose: Research-only three-level access grades with an Esri imagery check. NOT read by the app. catalog/map_points/WY.json carries verified | access-verified | pending; never merge this file into the catalog.

levels.verified: managing-agency boating-facility point (Boat Ramp/Launch/Takeout/Dock/Water Access in WGFD, BLM, USFS or NPS GIS) within 100 m of the WGFD River Access Point, within 150 m of the USGS NHD High Resolution named-river flowline, and Esri imagery verdict pass / pass-ramp-head
levels.access-verified: WGFD lists the site as a river launch/take-out, but the coordinate is a nearby agency parking/access feature (within 300 m), is >150 m from the NHD HR named flowline, or the imagery check did not show the launch at the pin (approximate area)
levels.pending: no agency facility coordinate within 300 m, private/permission/tribal/cross-state flag, or a WGFD data error

imageryVerdicts.pass: pin at the water's edge / launch
imageryVerdicts.pass-ramp-head: pin at the parking/ramp head with a visible route to water within ~40 m; kept verified with a note
imageryVerdicts.downgrade: verified candidate whose pin is not at a usable launch; published as access-verified

limitations: Esri tiles carry no capture date; channels move and NHD HR geometry can lag the imagery. The check confirms the marker sits at a plausible launch; it does not prove the site is open today. Imagery was reviewed for the 120 unflagged points that have an agency boat-facility point.
